steps.path: Marketplace → Connect your stuff → Google Workspace
steps.headline: The integration page keeps the one-row top card you picked: tile, name and description, then the buttons.
steps.changed: The other two alignments are removed. Compared here with round 3's layout, since round 4 already showed this one.
steps.notice: The card is about a third shorter, and everything lines up on one centre line like the Account profile card.

steps.headline: Theme page: no Installed pill, and the chips sit on one line that scrolls sideways when they don't fit.
steps.changed: The Installed pill is gone (Apply theme and Uninstall already say it). The chips no longer wrap; the row fades at the edge that has more.
steps.notice: Swipe, two-finger scroll or Shift + mouse wheel moves the chips; a normal wheel still scrolls the page. Plugin pages' chips scroll the same way.
steps.risk: A mouse user without Shift can't scroll the chips; the fade is the only hint there is more.

steps.path: Marketplace → Themes → Cotton Candy Sky (not installed)
steps.headline: The same page for a theme you don't have: name, heart, star, share, the chips, then Install.
steps.changed: Nothing visible changed here from round 4 (a theme you don't have never showed the Installed pill, and its one chip fits). It follows the same rules as the installed page.
steps.notice: Install is full width at the top of the right column.

steps.path: Marketplace on a phone (390 wide) → Meadow Mist
steps.headline: On a phone the theme page is one column; the Installed pill is gone from the name line.
steps.changed: Same top card as on a computer, above the picture and the colours.
steps.notice: Here every chip fits; when they don't, the row scrolls sideways with a swipe.
